svg.title: pi-path-bar — Your workspace, at a glance.
svg.desc: Illustrated Pi terminal showing a folder alias, Git branch and change counts, session name, local time, usage statistics and model information. Below: compact path and alias examples, plus the reading mode shortcut. This is a composed UI preview, not a live screenshot.
svg.metadata: Lettering and icons use Maple Mono NF CN. Font and icon attribution: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. No font files or external resources are required in the outlined version.
